cues: A harmonic is any whole number multiple of the fundamental.
An overtone is a tone that is actually produced above the fundamental, counted in order.
In a closed pipe, the first overtone is the third harmonic, because the second does not exist.
Mixing up these two words loses marks in almost every paper.
text: Harmonic or overtone? A harmonic is any whole number multiple of the fundamental. An overtone is a tone that is actually produced above the fundamental, counted in order. In a closed pipe, the first overtone is the third harmonic, because the second does not exist. Mixing up these two words loses marks in almost every paper.
